0022600018.text: The Knicks (1-3, 12th in the East) visit the 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East), with New York sitting 2.5 games back in the division and 0-1 on the road. The teams split 2-2 in the 2025-26 regular season, New York won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and the Knicks trail 0-1 for 2026-27 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20. New York is missing Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), Jabari Walker (out, knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain).
